title: Villa Del Sol | KEY.co
description_expanded: Outdoors, the private pool, spa, and covered patio create a serene oasis, while multiple balconies and a breathtaking rooftop deck provide stunning vistas of the Gulf. Enjoy a game room filled with arcade favorites, shuffleboard, and foosball, or step out to the exclusive private beach just minutes away. With luxurious sleeping arrangements, ensuite bathrooms, and thoughtful touches like dual laundry facilities, every detail ensures a seamless and indulgent escape. Perfectly situated in vibrant Destin, this exceptional home offers the ultimate combination of privacy, convenience, and sophistication, setting the stage for memories that will last a lifetime. Experience unparalleled luxury and comfort on the stunning Emerald Coast, where this nine-bedroom masterpiece redefines the art of beachside living. With space for up to 33 guests, this home offers an exceptional setting for unforgettable gatherings. A modern coastal design blends relaxed elegance with thoughtful functionality, featuring an open-concept living area and a chef’s dream kitchen complete with a Wolf gas range, three ovens, and a trio of refrigerators. Whether dining at the grand 16-seat table or gathering at the spacious kitchen island, this retreat effortlessly brings people together for cherished moments.
rooms_guidance: Bedroom 1 - First Floor: King + Triple Bunk
Bedroom 5 - Third Floor: Two Queen Over Queen Bunks
Bunk Area - First Floor: Double Over Double Bunk

Features: Guests assume all risk for use of pools
